Hi Naomi / Marissa,

We received renewed customer direction to remove all prompt/output artifacts, per our agreement. From: marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 01:32:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: Complete purge + certificate for prompt-output logs

Confirming ops plan and checklist.

Run details (ops checklist):
1) Pre-checks (01:45 UTC): identify active sessions, lock incoming traffic for delphi-prod-7 endpoints for 10m, snapshot current token counters.
2) Purge step A (02:00 UTC): erase prompt/output artifacts from primary KV store (shard map: s1..s4), purge ephemeral logs from /var/log/redwood/prompt-trace/* for tenant.
3) Purge step B (02:10 UTC): background sweep across S3 object prefixes (s3://redwood-delphi-prod/prompt-output/*) invoking lifecycle delete and verification paths.
4) Post-check (02:40 UTC): run verification script verify-purge --tenant delphi-prod-7 --run-id purge-20281019-DF-001 which returns list of zero-count matches and the audit hash.
5) Evidence collection: ops_run_log_purge-20281019.txt (redwood internal stub), S3 deletion manifest, and audit hash file.
6) Cert prep: hand to Security for signing.

I will attach the ops run log and the deletion manifest to this thread when complete. If internal teams need a different window, shout now.

Attachments: [Attachment: ops_run_log_purge-20281019.txt (text/plain, 18KB)]

--
Marissa Cole
Senior SRE, Redwood Dedicated Operations
